subject: PO field preflight and MSA redline coordination - MedSys onboarding
messages:
From: Anita Shah <procure@medsys.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: PO field mapping & MSA redline follow-up

Hi Grace / Laura,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. A couple of items from the portal side that we need to confirm before we finish provisioning your vendor account in Ariba:

- PO itemization: our finance team requires SKU-level line items on POs for vendors that supply multi-sku contracts. The portal enforces either (a) line-level SKU fields or (b) an uploaded CSV attachment that maps invoice lines back to a PO. Can you confirm which you can support?
- Vendor identifier mapping: we need a firm vendor_id + tax_jurisdiction field mapped to your GL code. We attached the PO_Field_Mapping_Template.csv for you to populate.
- MSA redline: attached is our standard onboarding redline (MSA_Redline_20270529.pdf). We flagged two items: clause 7.2 (data residency carveouts) and clause 11.4 (indemnity caps). If you have proposed edits, please send back a marked-up copy so our legal team can do the final pass.

Attachments: PO_Field_Mapping_Template.csv, MSA_Redline_20270529.pdf

Would appreciate confirmation by EOD tomorrow so we can complete provisioning.

Thanks,
Anita Shah
Sr. Procurement Manager
MedSys Health
procure@medsys.com

--
(If helpful, our portal onboarding doc is here: https://ariba.medsys.com/onboarding/12345)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding: PO field mapping & MSA redline follow-up

Forwarding Anita's note — quick summary and asks below.

Summary: MedSys needs either SKU-level line items on POs or an attached CSV that maps invoice lines to PO; they also returned an MSA redline with two flagged clauses. They want confirmation by EOD tomorrow.

Asks:
- Legal (Marissa / Laura): can you review the redline (attached) and advise if clause 7.2 (data residency carveouts) and indemnity language are deal-breakers or acceptable with limited edits? Please include the two-line guidance I can send back to Anita.
- Ops (Karthik): can Redwood support "uploaded CSV mapping" as a portal workaround if we cannot change our PO generation? If not, what would it take (engineering / billing change)?

I've attached the vendor's PO template they want us to fill. If Legal wants to propose edits, let's get a marked-up PDF we can send to Anita.

Thanks — I want this moving because they are aiming to close onboarding next week.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Date: 2027-05-29T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding: PO field mapping & MSA redline follow-up

Grace — quick legal read and suggested path. See attached PDF with comments (MSA_Legal_Comments_20270529.pdf).

TL;DR:
- Clause 7.2 (data residency carveouts) — ask MedSys to narrow this to circumstances where Redwood is reasonably unable to comply due to local law; we can accept a carveout limited to court orders / lawful requests. Recommend proposing the attached two-line edit.
- Clause 11.4 (indemnity caps) — the vendor redline removes our standard cap; propose we accept only if they reintroduce a mutual cap aligned to the SOW value.

Operationally: if we can provide a CSV mapping as their portal accepts, that is preferable to changing tokenized PO generation. Karthik — is the CSV mapping approach operationally feasible for Finance and Billing? If not, call out blockers and timing.

If you want, I'll draft a short reply to Anita with the two edits and ask them to re-send a marked copy or accept via DocuSign.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: MSA_Legal_Comments_20270529.pdf

Hi Grace / Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. MedSys is OK with the proposed legal edits Marissa suggested (I checked with their counsel). They will: 

- Narrow clause 7.2 to lawful orders only and accept the two-line language Marissa proposed.
- Reintroduce a mutual indemnity cap consistent with the SOW value; they will mark that in the MSA and re-upload.

Operational workaround: their portal can accept an uploaded PO-level CSV mapping as a temporary measure so you do not have to change your PO rendering immediately. I've attached a filled example of the PO_Field_Mapping_Template.csv with sample SKU mappings. If that works for Redwood, we'll proceed with provisioning once the redline is confirmed.

Next steps:
1) Marissa — if you can confirm the two-line language (I can accept a PDF or a DocuSign quick-accept).
2) Grace — if CSV mapping is OK, please return the filled template (attached) and we'll finalize provisioning.

Attachments: PO_Field_Mapping_Template.csv (filled), DocuSign_Onboarding_Link.txt

Thanks,
Tom Benson
Vendor Enablement Lead (MedSys Portal)
VendorX Services (on behalf of MedSys)
